usecases: Automated crypto arbitrage trading across multiple prediction markets and exchanges
Passive portfolio management with built-in risk controls for hands-free trading

ideas: Integrate on-chain analytics to detect real-time market inefficiencies and auto-execute strategies
Combine with decentralized identity for credit-based, permissionless trading bots
